description.value: KBF Farms is a local berry farm and produce operation with fruit stands throughout the Chilliwack/Abbotsford area, selling fresh-picked blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, corn, garlic, and ice cream. The 40040 No. 3 Road location serves as the farm's head office, while retail stands operate at Yale Road, Evans Road, and Young Road in Chilliwack. Visiting cyclists on routes near Highway 1 in the Fraser Valley may find this a convenient seasonal stop for fresh local produce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the head office at 40040 No. 3 Road in Abbotsford, BC, matching the OSM address, and the email matches. However, the OSM phone (+1-604-825-7781) differs from the website phone (604-852-9033), and the OSM name 'KBF Farm Market' differs from the website brand 'KBF Farms'. The website describes a seasonal fresh-produce fruit stand operation selling berries, corn, garlic, and ice cream, with no mention of cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-604-825-7781 but website shows 604-852-9033; using website value.
Name mismatch: OSM uses 'KBF Farm Market' but website consistently uses 'KBF Farms'.
OSM community is attributed to Chilliwack but the head office address (40040 No. 3 Road) is in Abbotsford per the website; the Chilliwack retail stands are at different addresses.

The OSM record appears to represent the farm head office/storage location rather than a public-facing retail fruit stand; cyclists would likely find the Chilliwack stands (Yale Rd, Evans Rd, Young Rd) more accessible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal farm market selling fresh local produce; a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Operation is seasonal (June–October per OSM tags). The website lists three separate Chilliwack retail fruit stand locations that may warrant their own OSM records.
